newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Banco Bansud sells $100 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Banco Bansud sells $100 mln in debt.

text.p: The following 144A debt issue from Argentina's Banco Bansud was priced in the private placement market on Friday, according to lead manager Credit Lyonnais.
Proceeds from the issue will be used for general corporate purposes, the manager said. Bansud is controlled by Banco Nacional de Mexico SA (Banamex), which holds a 57 percent stake.

Last week, Moody's Investors Service downgraded Banco Bansud's financial strength rating to E-plus from D. At the same time, Moody's affirmed the bank's long-term foreign currency bond and deposit ratings of B1.
